objective: Test whether target-cell conditional mean embeddings in a fixed RBF random-feature space provide one continuous OI geometry that preserves SAVE's first/second-moment ranking and captures periodic/local dependence.

ancestry.adaptation: RFF dimension 64 retained after frozen continuous_rff_save_ranking showed lower variance and better isolation behavior than dimension 128; this is exploratory development, not confirmation

random_fourier_geometry.input: one row-L2 normalization of observed embeddings
random_fourier_geometry.bandwidth_sample: at most 256 deterministic evenly spaced training-fold rows
random_fourier_geometry.bandwidth: gamma = 1 / (2 * median positive pairwise squared distance)
random_fourier_geometry.features: sqrt(2 / m) * cos(XW + b), W_ij sampled N(0, 2*gamma), b_j sampled Uniform(0, 2*pi), followed by row-L2 normalization
random_fourier_geometry.randomness: fixed from the existing fold seed
random_fourier_geometry.leakage: bandwidth and random map are constructed within each cross-fit training fold; holdout rows are transform-only

kernel_target_moment_geometry.residual_preconditioner: rank-8 pooled within-target-cell scaling and energetic-direction deflation
kernel_target_moment_geometry.global_standardization: symmetric global whitening with relative floor 1e-6 and absolute floor 1e-12
kernel_target_moment_geometry.mean: sum_h p_h mu_h mu_h^T in whitened RFF space
kernel_target_moment_geometry.mean_save: mean and SAVE moment matrices independently trace-normalized and added with fixed equal weight
kernel_target_moment_geometry.projection: top positive eigenvectors capped at rank 8 with deterministic signs
kernel_target_moment_geometry.leakage: all target cells, residual correction, whitening, target moments, and projection state are fitted inside each training fold

reference_heads.envelope: maximum held-out R2 across the four frozen heads on observed features

reference_performance_gate.interpretation: Aggregate claims require every per-panel performance floor and both nonlinear-head win counts to pass.

success_gate.overall_requirement: A method passes only if overall Spearman is at least SAVE, mean regret is no more than 0.02 worse, every listed first/second-moment family loses at most 0.10 Spearman, sinusoid gains at least 0.20, and triangle wave gains at least 0.15. Either frozen method may pass; no mixture weight or dimension is selected from outcomes.

axis_metrics.quality_at_fixed_nuisance: Primary monotonic ranking estimand within each nuisance level.
axis_metrics.nuisance_at_fixed_quality: Secondary sensitivity estimand within each quality level.

primary_contrasts: fixed RFF-mean-plus-SAVE versus RFF-mean and SAVE-only
both kernel target-moment methods versus residual-only and the privileged quadratic-lift ceiling
primary_metrics: panel and fixed-nuisance quality Spearman with the best-head envelope
negative actual-loss and negative loss-ratio Spearman
tie_rule: Average envelope performance across candidates tied at absolute tolerance 1e-12 for the maximum selector score.
scope: Exploratory synthetic development evidence on previously observed panel families; no production, confirmation, or generalization claim.
